jobs.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES:

Planning Management:

• Process and monitor information related to incoming goods received via email; manage the inbound mailbox.
• Schedule truck deliveries via email and telephone.
• Enter all announced shipments into planning files/Excel.
• Prepare and monitor mid- to long-term planning and forecasts (FCST).
• Maintain oversight of delivery schedules, slot bookings, and warehouse capacity utilization.
• Proactively solve problems and provide recommendations to Planning, Operations, Carriers, and Transport Management.
 

Receiving Operations:

• Create ASNs (Advance Shipping Notices) and Inbound Deliveries.
• Enter Purchase Orders (POs) into SAP, manage the Delivery Due List, and create inbound deliveries.
• Verify shipment labels and ensure control over the origin of goods and batches.
• Maintain, update, and analyze master data.
• Communicate with customs brokers regarding import and export customs clearance procedures.
• Initiate packaging adjustments to optimize logistics processes.
 

Continuous Improvement:

• Continuously assess opportunities for process improvement.
• Contribute ideas to optimize inbound goods flows, including transportation, booking slots, and packaging.
• Prepare reports on KPIs, carrier performance, packaging usage, and related metrics.
• Coordinate with carriers and suppliers when KPI targets are not achieved.
 

Driver Reception Desk:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for truck drivers; assign gates and manage check-in/check-out through the slot booking system.
• Process, create, and manage CMRs, packing lists, invoices, and export documentation for both incoming and outgoing AM/OE shipments.
• Provide drivers with all required documentation.
• Perform administrative tasks.
• Print locator labels and tickets.
• Resolve operational issues and exceptions.
 

Outbound (Backup Support):

• Create deliveries based on Excel files, emails, or SAP follow-up activities.
• Determine picking priorities based on collection schedules while considering warehouse picking capacity.
• Release and coordinate transportation for ICY shipments within and outside Europe.
• Release and monitor transportation activities for the French market.
• Arrange and track transportation for DACH, Nordic, Benelux, and other markets.
• Resolve issues related to transportation, goods, and materials.
• Act as the communication link between Customer Service, Operations, and Carriers.
• Analyze and follow up on transportation claims in C4C.

• Knowledge of warehouse processes, inbound operations, and picking techniques
• Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Proficiency in SAP, Microsoft Office, and slot booking systems.
• Able to work independently, in a structured manner, and under pressure.
• Strong communication skills.
• Customer-oriented mindset.
• Continuous improvement mentality.
• Team player.
• Strong focus on safety and compliance with regulations.
• Preferred: Experience in spare parts inventory management.

The Office Manager ensures the smooth daily operation of the shopping centre through administrative management, coordination with internal teams and tenants, and professional reception of visitors. They support management with reporting, agenda management and information handling, while maintaining accurate records and ensuring efficient communication across the site.

 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day‑to‑day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

 

Omschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.

Administrative Management
 She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.

Coordination
 She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.

Reception & Customer Relations
 As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.

Information Management
 She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.

Support to Management
 She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow‑up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision‑making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

 

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.

Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands‑on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping‑centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time‑management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.

At its Ghent facility, Legend Biotech focuses on the manufacturing of advanced CAR-T cell therapies for the treatment of multiple myeloma.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have a Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences and experience with cell culture? Would you like to contribute to groundbreaking therapies that are changing patients' lives worldwide?

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

For our client, a biotech company that is a fast-growing & innovative organization, we are looking for a warehouse associate.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

As a warehouse associate your responsibilities are; 

Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, …) in a controlled temperature environment.

Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies.

Working with equipment and material stored at cryogenic

Fill out the Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for incoming materials including: transport unloading, temperature control, integrity control, administrative paperwork related to following correct procedures.

Fill in forms & logbooks related to receiving, picking and outbound activities to comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) policies in the pharmaceutical environment.

Work closely together with the Operations and Quality department to support the Production and Lab activities for our start-up site.  

Work in a clean environment where you will wear dedicated gowning clothes.

Working in two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to process inbound, picking and outbound activities.

Collaborate with accounting, suppliers and business stakeholders in support of on-going operational efficiency efforts.

At Legend Biotech in Zwijnaarde, you will have the opportunity to participate in the production of advanced CAR-T cell therapies, an innovative form of cancer treatment. You will work in a highly technological GMP-regulated environment.
	
• Working daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment	
• Ensuring the cleanliness of equipment and production areas
Performing various steps within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including:
	
• Cell isolation	
• Cell selection, activation, and transduction	
• Cell culture	
• Aseptic processing	
• Filling and finishing operations	
• Cryopreservation
Manufacturing clinical and commercial ATMPs (Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products)
	
• Adhering to all applicable quality and safety standards
Performing in-process controls on batch samples while maintaining the highest quality standards

Strictly following SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), batch records, and GMP guidelines
	
• Recording and managing GMP documentation to ensure compliance and traceability
Supporting environmental monitoring and the maintenance of GMP production areas

Who are you?

You are a detail-oriented team player who enjoys working in an innovative manufacturing environment.

You have:
	
• A Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, or an equivalent field	
• Initial experience with cell culture	
• Experience in a GMP environment and/or ATMP manufacturing is a strong asset	
• Good command of English, both written and spoken	
• Willingness to work in a shift-based system	
• A hands-on mentality and strong attention to detail

Industrial investment projects in a process environment

In this role, you lead complex multidisciplinary CAPEX projects within an industrial process setting from start to finish. You retain full responsibility throughout the project lifecycle for scope, budget, timing, quality and safety. The assignment covers both greenfield initiatives and substantial modifications to existing industrial installations.

Key responsibilities

• Lead industrial engineering projects from feasibility and concept phase through commissioning and final handover to operations.
• Set and manage project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and the baseline schedule in MS Project.
• Steer all project stages, including pre-study, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, on-site execution, commissioning and transfer.
• Serve as the main accountable point of contact for stakeholders and management during the full project trajectory.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary internal and external teams across mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS domains.
• Control scope changes, project risks, claims and deviations with impact on cost or planning.
• Provide clear reporting on progress, decisions and issues to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You have at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• You also bring at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You have solid experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval processes and the commissioning of industrial installations.
• Experience in the process industry is required.
• You have strong hands-on expertise in MS Project and are used to building and owning project schedules, not just tracking them.
• You work at academic level and combine strong analytical capabilities with a broad helicopter view.
Non-technical profile requirements

• You work autonomously and take full ownership of your assignments.
• You demonstrate strong leadership and can challenge stakeholders and contractors when necessary.
• You communicate confidently with stakeholders at every organisational level.
• You bring natural authority to complex industrial environments.
Methodology / certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent
